---
title: "Why **laplacekit**"
---

**laplacekit** is an extensible, modern Laplace-approximation library for
PyTorch, built on a plugin system. Modern models like Hugging Face LLMs,
diffusion models and reward models are supported. Here is what it adds over
`laplace-torch`, `laplax` and `posteriors`.

## What's new?

**Plugin system.** Think Neovim or VS Code. A new Laplace method is a package:
install it with `pip` and pass it to `lk.laplace`. The built-in methods
are written the exact same way, against the same public interfaces, with no
special access. So a third-party method is a first-class citizen, and several
plugins can be mixed in one fit. Extending `laplace-torch` means subclassing
`BaseLaplace` (a few thousand lines) and sending a PR. `laplax` and
`posteriors` are libraries of functions: they can be composed, or a new method
written from scratch, but there is no plugin host. The
[Plugins](plugins/overview.qmd) tab shows the contracts, and [A
curvature](plugins/curvature.py) walks through a new method.

## How it compares

|                                                 | **laplacekit**                                                                          | [`laplace-torch`](https://github.com/aleximmer/Laplace) | [`laplax`](https://github.com/laplax-org/laplax) | [`posteriors`](https://github.com/normal-computing/posteriors) |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Framework                                       | PyTorch                                                                                                 | PyTorch                                                 | JAX                                              | PyTorch                                                        |
| LLMs (Hugging Face, LoRA) without special code  | yes (`lk.transformers.laplace_lora` on a published LoRA adapter; tested on tiny Llama, GPT-2 and Mamba) | with workarounds                                        | JAX models only                                  | yes                                                            |
| Diffusion models                                | yes (`lk.diffusers.laplace` on a pretrained DDPM)                                                       | no                                                      | JAX models only                                  | ?                                                              |
| Fit from your own training loop                 | yes (several processes with `lk.distributed.all_reduce`, tested on CPU; multi-GPU planned)              | no                                                      | ?                                                | yes                                                            |
| Fully type-checked, with typed extension points | yes                                                                                                     | no                                                      | ?                                                | ?                                                              |
| Options as typed objects and checked literals   | yes                                                                                                     | no                                                      | no                                               | yes                                                            |
| Differentiate through the whole fit             | yes                                                                                                     | no                                                      | yes                                              | yes                                                            |
| Diagonal and full curvature                     | yes                                                                                                     | yes                                                     | yes                                              | yes                                                            |
| KFAC                                            | yes (`curvlinops`)                                                                                      | yes                                                     | no                                               | no                                                             |
| Low-rank curvature                              | yes (`lk.LowRankGGN`, Nyström sketch)                                                                   | yes                                                     | yes                                              | no                                                             |
| Last-layer Laplace                              | yes                                                                                                     | yes                                                     | ?                                                | through a parameter subset                                     |
| Subnetwork Laplace                              | yes (`lk.subnet`, `lk.subsets.from_mask`)                                                               | yes                                                     | ?                                                | through a parameter subset                                     |
| Function-space (GP) Laplace                     | yes (subset of data; ELLA, VaLLA and FSP-Laplace in `lk.gp`)                                            | yes                                                     | ?                                                | no                                                             |
| Linearized predictive                           | yes                                                                                                     | yes                                                     | yes                                              | yes (diagonal posteriors)                                      |
| Marginal-likelihood tuning                      | yes                                                                                                     | yes                                                     | yes                                              | no                                                             |
| Marglik training                                | yes (`lk.marglik`)                                                                                      | yes                                                     | ?                                                | ?                                                              |

"planned" means on the roadmap for the first alpha. "?" means not checked yet.
The other columns come from each library's documentation and source as of
November 2026; corrections are welcome.

## Agent workflow

**laplacekit** is designed so that a coding agent can write a new Laplace
method without reading the core:

- Each extension point is a small typed interface in its own file, and `ty`
  tells the agent it got something wrong in seconds.
- Errors say what's missing _and_ what would work instead, so the agent can fix
  its own mistakes. A wrong argument type, such as `hessian_approx="kron"` or
  the class `lk.KFAC` for an instance, raises a `TypeError` that names what to
  pass.
- `print(post)` shows every choice a fit made, and `torch.manual_seed` (or a
  `generator=` argument) makes reruns identical, as in torch.
- `lk.testing` checks a new plugin against its interface and the laws it must
  satisfy.
- `print(lk.health())` reports whether the install works: the torch version,
  the `curvlinops` pin, autograd on a small model, float64, and each plugin's own
  checks.
- The docs have an [`llms.txt`](https://laplacekit.org/llms.txt) index and a
  Markdown copy of every page, the API reference included, for the agent to
  read.

## Coming from `laplace-torch`

The table maps the public API of `laplace-torch` (as of November 2026) to
**laplacekit**. `fs` is `laplacekit.function_space`. "Not in 0.1a"
marks what **laplacekit** doesn't have yet.

| [`laplace-torch`](https://github.com/aleximmer/Laplace) | **laplacekit** |
| --- | --- |
| **Fitting** | |
| `Laplace(model, likelihood, ...)`, then `la.fit(loader)` | `lk.laplace(model, data, likelihood)` |
| `fit(loader, override=False)` | `lk.laplace(..., prior=post)` (continual learning) |
| `dict_key_x`, `dict_key_y` | `lk.data.from_loader(loader, prepare=...)`, which returns `lk.Batch` |
| `backend`, `backend_kwargs` | the fields of the `hessian_approx` object, such as `lk.KFAC(fisher="mc")` |
| `enable_backprop=True` | always on |
| `temperature` | none |
| `state_dict()`, `load_state_dict()` | `lk.save(post, f)`, `lk.load(f, model)` |
| `progress_bar`, `verbose` | not in 0.1a |
| **Curvature** | |
| `hessian_structure="full"` | `hessian_approx=lk.DenseGGN(joint=True)` |
| `"kron"` | `lk.KFAC()` |
| `"diag"` | `lk.DiagGGN()` |
| `"lowrank"` | `lk.LowRankGGN(rank)` |
| `EFInterface`, `CurvlinopsEF` | `lk.DenseGGN(fisher="empirical")`, `lk.DiagGGN(fisher="empirical")`, `lk.KFAC(fisher="empirical")` |
| `CurvlinopsHessian` | `lk.DenseHessian()` |
| `stochastic=True`, `num_samples` | `lk.DiagGGN(fisher="mc", mc_samples=...)`, `lk.KFAC(fisher="mc", mc_samples=...)` |
| A subclass of `CurvatureInterface` | a plugin against `lk.core.Curvature` |
| **Subsets** | |
| `subset_of_weights="last_layer"`, `last_layer_name` | `lk.subsets.last_layer` (the default), `lk.subsets.named("fc.*")` |
| `"all"` | `lk.subsets.all` |
| `"subnetwork"`, `subnetwork_indices` | `lk.subsets.from_mask(masks)` |
| `RandomSubnetMask`, `LargestMagnitudeSubnetMask` | `lk.subnet.random(n)`, `lk.subnet.largest_magnitude(n)` |
| `LargestVarianceDiagLaplaceSubnetMask` | `lk.subnet.largest_variance(post, n)` |
| `LargestVarianceSWAGSubnetMask` | `lk.subnet.largest_variance(lk.subnet.swag_variance(model, data, ...), n)` |
| `ParamNameSubnetMask`, `ModuleNameSubnetMask` | `lk.subsets.named("0.weight")`, `lk.subsets.named("0.*")` |
| **Priors and tuning** | |
| `prior_precision` (scalar, per layer, per weight) | `lk.priors.Isotropic`, `lk.priors.Layerwise`, `lk.priors.Diagonal` |
| `prior_mean` | `lk.priors.Isotropic(prior_precision, mean=...)` |
| `optimize_prior_precision(method="marglik")` | the default `hyper_tuner=lk.MarginalLikelihood()` of `lk.laplace`, or `lk.tune(post)` |
| `method="gridsearch"`, `log_prior_prec_min`, `grid_size`, ... | `lk.tune(post, lk.GridSearch(objective, values=torch.logspace(...)))` |
| `val_loader`, `loss` | `lk.objectives.predictive_nll(val)`, `lk.objectives.brier`, `lk.objectives.ece` |
| `log_marginal_likelihood(prior_precision, sigma_noise)` | `post.log_marglik()`, on `copy.replace(post, prior=..., likelihood=lk.Gaussian(sigma=...))` |
| **Likelihoods** | |
| `"regression"`, `sigma_noise` | `lk.Gaussian()` (learned), `lk.Gaussian(sigma=...)` (fixed) |
| `"classification"` | `lk.Categorical()` |
| `BernoulliLikelihood` | `lk.Bernoulli()` |
| `"reward_modeling"`, `BradleyTerryLikelihood` | `lk.reward.bradley_terry()` on `lk.reward.pairwise(model)` |
| `HeteroscedasticGaussianLikelihood(eps)` | `lk.heteroscedastic.MeanVarianceGaussian(eps)` |
| `get_likelihood("...")`, a `Likelihood` subclass | the object itself, `lk.likelihoods.from_log_prob(fn)` |
| **Predictives** | |
| `pred_type="glm"`, `link_approx="probit"`, `"mc"`, `"bridge"`, `"bridge_norm"` | `lk.predict(post, x, method=lk.Linearized(link=...))` with `lk.Probit()`, `lk.MC(n)`, `lk.Bridge()`, `lk.Bridge(normalized=True)` |
| `pred_type="nn"` | `lk.WeightSamples(n)` |
| `functional_variance`, `functional_covariance` | `lk.predict_outputs(post, x)` |
| `functional_samples`, `predictive_samples` | `lk.sample_outputs(post, x, n, kind="linearized")`, `kind="network"` |
| `sample(n)` | `post.sample(n)` |
| `log_prob(value)` | `post.log_prob(params)` |
| `feature_reduction` (LLMs) | the model's own forward, `lk.predict(..., select=lk.transformers.last_token)` |
| **Function space** | |
| `hessian_structure="gp"`, `n_subset` | `lk.function_space.laplace(model, data, likelihood, method=lk.function_space.SubsetOfData(n_subset))` |
| `independent_outputs=True` | `lk.function_space.SubsetOfData(n_subset, structure="independent")` |
| `predictive_moments(x)` | `gp.at(x)`, `lk.predict_outputs(gp, x)` |
| `ELLA(subsample_size, n_eigenvalues)` | `lk.gp.ELLA(lk.gp.from_data(m), rank=k)` |
| `ELLA.optimize_hyperparameters` | `lk.tune(gp, lk.GridSearch(lk.objectives.predictive_nll(val), values))` |
| `VaLLA(inducing_locations, num_inducing, inducing_classes)` | `lk.gp.VaLLA(lk.gp.kmeans(n_points))`, `lk.gp.fixed(x, coords=...)` |
| `VaLLA.fit(iterations, lr)`, `alpha`, `mc_softmax_samples` | `lk.gp.fit_variational(gp, data, n_steps=..., lr=..., alpha=..., n_samples=...)` |
| none | `lk.gp.fsp_laplace` |
| **Training** | |
| `marglik_training(model, loader, likelihood, ...)` | `lk.marglik.train(model, data, likelihood, optimizer=..., epochs=...)` |
| `prior_structure="scalar"`, `"layerwise"`, `"diag"` | `prior=lk.priors.Isotropic`, `lk.priors.Layerwise`, `lk.priors.Diagonal` |
| `prior_prec_init`, `lr_hyp`, `n_hypersteps`, `marglik_frequency`, `n_epochs_burnin` | `prior=lk.priors.Layerwise(init)`, `lr_hyper`, `n_hypersteps`, `marglik_frequency`, `n_epochs_burnin` |
| **Utilities** | |
| `Kron`, `KronDecomposed` | `lk.core.KronEigenbasis`, `lk.priors.KronSum.of(post)` |
| `RunningNLLMetric` and the other running metrics | `lk.objectives.predictive_nll` |
